mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2.5% (current level 2.01) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through lower cost of capital for corporate valuation.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 2.5%, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.1 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that heighten recession risk, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days through reduced consumer spending confidence.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.1pp in 1 month, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent monthly increases in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) exceeding 0.5% each indicate robust aggregate demand that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through synchronized consumer and housing sector strength.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both rise > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS rise > 0.5% in 1 month, or Rank IC for interaction signal falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-constrained economy (INDPRO growth rate below 0.5% annualized), a monthly decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals worsening supply chain bottlenecks that increase inflation expectations and trigger equity sell-offs, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO growth rate is below 0.5% annualized, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above its 12-month moving average indicates sustained consumer spending strength that supports corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through improved earnings visibility.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS is above its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals accelerating inflation that prompts Federal Reserve tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days through higher real interest rates and reduced equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL rises > 0.3pp in 1 month, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent monthly increases in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) exceeding 50k and unemployment rate (UNRATE) declines exceeding 0.1 percentage points indicate a tightening labor market that boosts consumer confidence and spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through synchronized labor and consumption strength.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises > 50k and UNRATE falls > 0.1pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS rises > 50k and UNRATE falls > 0.1pp in 1 month, or Rank IC for interaction signal falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market boom (HOUST > 1000), a monthly decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals cooling residential activity that reduces consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through reduced household wealth effects.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST > 1000 and HOUST declines in the month, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.03.
